p.MCP-TOOLS: The server exposes exactly lean_ai_native_scan(carrier), lean_ai_native_check(carrier, subject), and lean_ai_native_verify_witness(carrier, subject, witness). Arguments are objects with the named string members only. Unknown, missing and wrongly typed members refuse before engine execution.

p.MCP-CONTEXT: Server startup fixes the project root and optional trusted toolchain directory. Tool calls cannot supply operation, project root or toolchain overrides. Carrier and witness paths are relative to that root; the shared engine enforces containment.

p.MCP-REPLY: Every valid tool call directly invokes lean-ai-native-check::execute with the same typed Request used by the language CLI. MCP text content is the serialized Reply without reconstructed status or extra report fields; isError equals the negation of Reply.ok. Invalid arguments use Reply::invalid_request. The server never dispatches a CLI found through PATH.

p.MCP-CLAIM-BOUNDARY: A carrier association is declared traceability. A successful model check grants only the engine's explicit model claim under its recorded assumptions. It does not establish a Rust implementation refinement, current host mixed-language composition, or owner acceptance.
